title: If the default changes while New Customer is open, the form keeps its term
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a second user, user B, signed in with the "Admin" role in a second browser (you are signed in as an Admin in the first).
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Choose a name for the new customer, customer A.
  • Make sure Net 30 is active.
  • Start with your browser showing the Customers page and user B's browser showing the Credit Terms page.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Customer".
  2. Type the name of customer A in Customer Name.
  3. In user B's browser, click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 30" row.
  4. In user B's browser, click "Make Default for New Customers".
  5. In user B's browser, click "Make Default".
  6. In your browser, look at Credit Terms.
  7. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Customer" window opens.

Step 2:

  • Credit Terms reads COD (Default).

Step 3:

  • The menu opens.

Step 4:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 5:

  • User B sees "Net 30 is now the default".

Step 6:

  • It still reads COD (the form keeps the term it showed).

Step 7:

  • The customer is created on COD, the term the form showed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-E1: “If the default changes while New Customer is open, the form keeps the term already shown; the user's Save uses what the form shows.”
